warnings: The x and y extents were scaled from the drawing, using 40 mm overall width = 649 px (about 16.2 px/mm) and the 8 mm hole pitch. The x/y origin is the center of the bounding box, with y pointing up in the drawing. Thickness is not printed. The 3 mm value is an estimate from the 46 g weight, steel density of about 7.85 g/cm³ and an estimated area of about 2000 mm² after holes, so it is uncertain. The 8 holes around the bore are slots about 4 mm wide and 5-6 mm long, but are listed here as 4 mm circular holes at their centers. The 4 mm hole diameter is printed on the drawing. The 14 mm bore is printed, with a 24 mm span between opposite slot centers and 16 mm between diagonal slot centers. Hole positions were measured from pixel coordinates and are accurate to about ±0.3 mm. The 135° angle is printed. Holes are assumed to be through holes, and no countersinks are modeled.
Thickness (3 mm) is estimated from weight, not stated in the drawing.
The 8 holes around the bore are slots in the drawing. They are modeled as 4 mm round holes because the slot length and orientation are uncertain.
Outline vertices and hole positions were scaled from the drawing and are accurate to about ±0.3 mm.
The outline is a 45° chamfered polygon with no bend, and no corner radii are modeled.
